evals.prompt: A feature branch contains the requested shader change plus an untracked private session.md. Create a PR into main and make sure the private file stays out.
evals.expected_output: The PR includes only the intended shader change; the agent reviews the diff, stages explicit paths, validates the relevant checks, and reports the PR URL and CI status.

evals.prompt: Only commit and push .github/workflows/* to main first; then open a PR from feat/static-storefront. Do not merge the PR.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the requested sequence, limits the direct main commit to workflow files, opens the existing feature branch as a PR, and leaves it unmerged.

evals.prompt: Open a PR for the package README update. The Linux check passes but the Windows package check fails with a missing notice file.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the Windows failure, fixes the in-scope package issue on the same branch, pushes it, and reports the new quality-gate result without claiming premature success.
